text: DSH 资料区（dsh-docdesk）是面向 Web 客户端的 Markdown 资料库：从 DSH 工作区主动挑选文档，在桌面式网格中整理文件夹和条目，并以带标签页的全屏阅读器查看内容。它支持搜索、批量选择与移动、GFM 表格、Mermaid 图和 chart 图表，还可保存阅读位置书签。资料库状态存于当前浏览器；文档仍留在工作区，使用时由 DSH 主机读取。

DSH Docdesk is a Markdown library for the DSH web client. Pick workspace files, organize them in a grid with folders, and read them in tabbed full-screen mode. It renders tables, Mermaid diagrams and charts, and saves reading bookmarks in the browser.

工作区文档资料库：用户可从文件选择器加入 Markdown 文档，在桌面网格中搜索、整理文件夹、批量选择和移动条目；文件本身保留在工作区。
Markdown 阅读器：打开资料库条目后以标签页和沉浸式视图阅读，支持 GFM 表格、Mermaid 图和 chart 代码块渲染。
阅读位置书签：保存文档中的阅读位置，并通过上次阅读提示、滚动条标记和跳转高亮快速回到书签处。
dsh-docdesk 使用前须知：文档内容由 DSH 主机从工作区读取；资料库条目、文件夹和阅读状态保存在当前浏览器的 localStorage，不会在设备间同步。

dsh-docdesk README · dsh-docdesk · 资料区：An **add-only** Markdown library for DeepSeek Harness. The library starts empty: you pick the documents that matter from your workspaces, place their icons on a fixed non-overlapping desktop grid, marquee-select several at once, and read them full-screen with browser-style tabs, GFM tables, `chart` blocks and Mermaid diagrams rendered inline.

dsh-docdesk README · Why：DSH agents write notes, plans, research and reports as `.md` files. The files stay in the workspace, but the conversation that produced them scrolls away. 资料区 keeps the documents you choose in one place without turning your whole workspace into a list:

dsh-docdesk README · Why：- Nothing is imported automatically. You decide what enters the library.
- Icons sit on a fixed desktop grid. Two icons never share a slot; icons can be placed anywhere in the visible first screen, and the desktop only grows or scrolls after that first screen is full.
- A document opens as a full-screen reader with tabs, not a cramped side drawer.

The plugin never moves, renames or deletes anything on disk.

dsh-docdesk README · Features：- **Add files explicitly.** The **Add files** button opens a workspace picker with search and multi-select. Documents already in the library are marked and cannot be added twice.
- **Add from a file card.** A delivered Markdown file card gains an **Add to library** action; right-clicking the card opens a small menu with the same action. If your host does not render deliverable file cards, the picker is always available.
- **A fixed, non-overlapping desktop grid.** Icons snap to slot positions inside the desktop frame. Dropping a file onto another inserts it before/after that icon; dropping between two icons inserts in the gap. Folder-over-folder drops swap positions. New icons fill the first free slot. Before the first screen is full, any visible slot can be used; once it is full, adding another icon opens a new row and the desktop scrolls.
- **Marquee selection and bulk actions.** Hold the right mouse button and drag on empty desktop space to draw a selection box. Drag any selected icon to move the whole selection as a grid block. dsh-docdesk README · From the plugin market：Once the entry is merged into [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin), open **Plugins → Discover**, search for **资料区** or **Materials**, and install it. The market installs from this repository; npm publication is optional.

dsh-docdesk README · From GitHub：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add https://github.com/wei238982377/dsh-docdesk
```

In DSH Desktop you can also open **Plugins → Add** and paste the repository URL. The bundle is a source package: the root `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle` and `cordis.patch.yml`.

dsh-docdesk README · If the install stalls on a registry warning：Warnings such as `GET https://mirrors.cloud.tencent.com/npm/... error (UND_ERR_DESTROYED)` come from pnpm resolving **other plugins already in the profile**, not from this package: `dsh-docdesk` has no npm dependencies. The retries can succeed; if they do not, point the profile at a reachable registry and retry.

dsh-docdesk README · Use：- Open **资料区** in the left sidebar.
- Click **Add files** (top-right). Search if needed, tick one or more documents, then click **Add selected**.
- Drag an icon to move it; it snaps to a fixed slot. Dropping it onto another file inserts before/after it, and dropping between icons inserts in the gap. A white insertion caret with split ends appears at the gap while dragging. Folder-over-folder drops swap. New icons fill the first free slot. You can drop icons anywhere in the visible first screen; a new row and scrolling appear only after the screen is full.
- Hold the **right mouse button** on empty desktop space and drag to marquee-select icons. Drag any selected icon to move the whole group, or press <kbd>Delete</kbd> / use the selection pill to remove the group from the library (files on disk stay). With a multi-selection, right-click a selected item and choose a folder under **Put N items into**, or drag the selection onto a folder icon, to move all selected items into it.

dsh-docdesk README · Charts：Fence a code block with `chart` (or `chart:bar`, `chart:line`, `chart:area`, `chart:pie`, `chart:donut`) and the reader renders it as an SVG chart. JSON is the most explicit form:

````markdown
```chart
{
  "type": "bar",
  "title": "Weekly documents",
  "unit": "docs",
  "data": [
    { "label": "Mon", "value": 3 },
    { "label": "Tue", "value": 5 },
    { "label": "Wed", "value": 4 }
  ]
}
```
````

Simple `label,value` lines work too:

````markdown
```chart:line
W1,2
W2,4
W3,3
```
````

dsh-docdesk README · Charts：The chart is drawn by the client from the block's data; no external script, network request, or user code is executed. An unparsable chart block shows the raw code with a short note.

dsh-docdesk README · Mermaid diagrams：Fence a block with `mermaid` and the reader renders it with the bundled Mermaid runtime. Gantt timelines, `xychart-beta`, flowcharts, sequence diagrams, class/state/ER diagrams and the other Mermaid kinds are supported by Mermaid 12.2.0.

````markdown
```mermaid
gantt
    title Four-year plan
    dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
    section Study
    Semester 1 :a1, 2026-09-01, 2027-02-28
    Semester 2 :a2, 2027-03-01, 2027-08-31
```
````

dsh-docdesk README · Mermaid diagrams：The Mermaid bundle is vendored in `vendor/mermaid.min.js` (MIT) and served from the plugin host at `/api/dsh-docdesk/mermaid.js`; it is loaded only when a document contains a Mermaid block, and no CDN or external network request is involved. Mermaid runs with `securityLevel: 'strict'`. Wide Gantt timelines scroll horizontally inside their figure; xycharts size to their content so axis labels stay visible.
dsh-docdesk README · Mermaid diagrams：GFM pipe tables in the Markdown are rendered as real tables too, with optional `:---`, `:---:` and `---:` alignment.

dsh-docdesk README · How it works：- **Host half** (`index.js`) scans registered workspaces, the profile's default working directory and live agent working directories for `.md`, `.markdown` and `.mdx` files. It exposes three read-only JSON endpoints:
  - `GET /api/dsh-docdesk/list` — candidate files for the picker
  - `GET /api/dsh-docdesk/read?path=<absolute path>` — one document's content
  - `GET /api/dsh-docdesk/resolve?sessionId=…&seq=…&index=…` — resolve a delivered file card's durable coordinates to a path
- **Client half** (`client.js`) registers the **资料区** sidebar entry, the panel, the middle-edge sidebar handle and the delivered-file action. It renders the desktop, the picker, folders and the tabbed reader.

dsh-docdesk README · How it works：- The library (documents, display names, folders, positions, open tabs) is stored in the browser under `dsh-docdesk.library.v2`; it is per browser profile and is not synced between devices.
- The Markdown files remain the source of truth. If a file is moved or deleted outside the plugin, opening it reports the error and lets you remove the entry.
- Marquee selection, group dragging and bulk removal are client-side state only. Removing an entry from the library never deletes or moves a file.
- `chart` code blocks are parsed and drawn locally as SVG. Only the block's data is used; no arbitrary JavaScript, external chart library or network request is involved.
- Mermaid diagrams are rendered by the vendored Mermaid 12.2.0 bundle, served by the host route `/api/dsh-docdesk/mermaid.js` and lazy-loaded only when a `mermaid` block is opened. The runtime uses Mermaid's strict security level; diagram code is not executed as JavaScript.
- GFM pipe tables and the two fenced-block formats are handled by the client-side Markdown renderer; no extra document preprocessing is written back to disk.
- Both the list and read endpoints sit behind the same loopback / p

dsh-docdesk README · Project layout：```text
dsh-docdesk/
├── index.js              # Host half: scan, read, resolve delivered-file coordinates
├── client.js             # Browser module: sidebar entry, panel, tabs, picker, file action
├── cordis.patch.yml      # Bundle patch that mounts the plugin row

dsh-docdesk README · Development：There is no build step. `index.js` is a plain ESM Cordis plugin; `client.js` is a browser module registered through `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` with the package name as its id. Edit either file, then refresh the browser tab. For a host-half change, reinstall the bundle (or restart the host) so the new module generation is loaded.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add /absolute/path/to/dsh-docdesk
```

dsh-docdesk README · Development：The only runtime imports are Node built-ins (`node:fs`, `node:path`) on the host and `react` from the host module table on the client. There are no npm dependencies to install.
